project.name: Veridanth — Big questions. Brighter futures.
project.objective: Replace abstract artwork with100 distinct realistic people-free photographs showing the actual settings, equipment and materials of each research service.
project.audience: Students, academics, businesses and institutions seeking research support in Ghana.
project.governing_idea: Curiosity into clarity: Ghanaian context, human research and possibility.

creative_system.visual_thesis: Real research, clearly pictured: natural-light photographic scenes specific to each service.

palette.contrast: Strong white and gold typography over consistently shaded cinematic imagery.

creative_system.composition: One specific photographed scene per service, integrated into a readable responsive catalogue.
creative_system.camera: Service photographs use varied real-world close-up, overhead, eye-level and architectural compositions.
creative_system.lighting: Natural daylight and believable interior illumination.
creative_system.typography: Self-hosted DM Sans; Libre Caslon Display italic highlights.
creative_system.motion: An 8-second silent film, restrained hover and entry effects, explicit pause/play controls.
creative_system.interface: Mobile reflow, readable body text, visible keyboard focus, existing functional research catalogue and desk.
invariants: Exactly one separately generated photographic image per service.
No people, hands, portraits, silhouettes or human reflections in service images.
No abstract sculpture, fantasy or CGI aesthetic.
Readable body text and all existing catalogue interactions retained.

rights_and_claims.description: Original generated visuals with no third-party footage, real likeness reference or music.

rights_and_claims.description: 100 services, 13 research pathways, 13 expertise areas and nine client groups reflect the current catalogue. No customer counts, testimonials or affiliations invented.
100 proposed scoped services, 13 expertise areas, 9 client groups; photographs are illustrative and contain no humans.
100 individual realistic photographic illustrations represent each service, with no people or shared service images. A separate library scene introduces the page.
rights_and_claims.evidence: Per-image reviews in photo-batch manifests, five contact sheets, and scripts/verify-service-photos.py.

review_notes: All 100 service images and the exclusive hero visually reviewed for realistic setting, service relevance and absence of people.
Human-like poster images and small screen avatars found during production were replaced before release.
100 unique service URLs, source files, prompts and final image hashes verified; all photos decode at 1200x800.
Superseded abstract artwork removed from the current public assets.
Featured opening services show varied business, school, healthcare, fieldwork and research contexts.
320px mobile reflow checked: 305px document width matches 305px viewport content width; body text 17px.
Matching service-detail photograph, desktop layout and preserved catalogue functions checked.
TypeScript, catalogue checks and production build passed. Archive prepared for the existing private Site.
Final browser verification: curated 12-image opening collection, page 2 with zero repeated image URLs, school curriculum filter and correct photo, service-detail image load.
